My 'Certo' Experiences
I usually will smoke marijuana up until the day before my urine analysis test. I use no other illegal drugs.
I purchase 1  6 fl. oz. box of Certo from my local super wal-mart in the baking aisle for $2.87. I do not (no matter how hungry) eat the day of the test until after the test is over. The food can soak up the Certo and prevent it from being effective. I will start the drinking process no more than 2 hours before the expected UA. I open the first package out of the box and pour it in a 44 oz. cup or larger. After pouring the full pkg. in the cup I fill the rest of the way with plain water and drink all of this mixture. It tastes very nasty! Meanwhile, I urinate as frequently as possible. It may give me diarhea and make my stomach cramp slightly.
Next, I refill the same cup or mug with nothing but water, drink all of this, and still urinate as often as possible.
Now, I empty the second pkg. into my cup. I fill the cup the rest of the way with water and drink all again. I will continue to urinate as often as possible.
If questioned about it I always replied, 'I drank a lot of water beforehand to be prepared for the UA.' Certo has never affected me negatively besides the slight stomach cramps and sometimes diarhea.
I have never had a positive test result using Certo.  I never take any medications or vitamins before I have taken the UA.
